title: ros2 launch: "file was not found in the share directory of package" - the install step, stale copies and --symlink-install (measured)
excerpt: ros2 launch only searches install/<pkg>/share/<pkg>, never src/. Missing data_files, a glob that matches nothing, or no install(DIRECTORY launch) in CMake all give this error. Plus stale copies and new files under --symlink-install. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
